$comment: Justified architecture-gate exemptions (#80). Every entry needs rule, path, reason, and owner or ref. Scripts/architecture.mjs fails with waiver-contract when an entry is not justified. domain-pure, host-scope and no-lib-from-core cannot be waived at all, and domain/** accepts no waiver. Since #70 the retired lib/ layer has no waivers: host/** owns ambient state by rule, and only the two I/O adapters below are exempt.

waivers.reason: The git adapter is the single process-spawning boundary; no other module implements VcsPort with a child process.
The filesystem adapter is the single node:fs boundary; the store port needs atomic writes, lock files, and raw store reads.
